ORANGE POSSET// aka the easiest dessert you'll ever make 🍊✨ you only need 10 minutes of prep time, and just three ingredients: cream, sugar, and citrus.  I made this last summer and haven’t stopped thinking about it since. It’s rich, silky, light and full of flavor. + it's also SO EASY to eat too. like you won't want to stop.  comment RECIPE and i'll send ya the deets, or snag it down below!  Serve it in little jars, in an orange peel, try different citrus like grapefruit, lemon, blood orange etc! the possibilities are endless.  SAVE this one for when you want to impress without turning on the oven because we all know it's going to be too hot for that this summer!  1 cup heavy cream 1/3 cup cane sugar 1/4 cup orange juice 1-2 tsp vanilla  Zest from 1 orange 3 Orange Peel halves, or 4oz ramekins In a bowl, mix together the sugar and orange zest. Use your hands to rub them together until the sugar is fragrant and tinted orange. Whisk in the heavy cream and vanilla until smooth. Pour the mixture into a saucepan over low heat and bring to a gentle simmer. Remove from heat and immediately stir in the orange juice. Strain the mixture through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl to remove the zest. Cut two oranges in half, scoop out the insides, and pour the cream mixture into each hollowed-out orange half (or use ramekins if preferred). Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight until set. Garnish with a mint sprig before serving, if desired. #orangeposset #posset #easydessertrecipe #nobakedesserts

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

Butter chicken wrap Ingredients  For the chicken : 2 lb chicken, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp cumin powder  1 tsp garam masala  1 tsp coriander powder  1/2 tsp turmeric powder  1 tbsp garlic paste  1 tsp red chili powder  4 tbsp whole milk yogurt  2 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil for marinating 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the butter chicken sauce: 2 tbsp butter  1  yellow onion, diced 1 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes  1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp cumin powder  1 tsp coriander powder  1/2 tsp garam masala  1 tsp red chili powder  1/2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp fenugreek leaves  3/4 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream  2 tbsp butter (finish)  To Assemble 6 tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Butter chicken  Sumac onions Cucumbers  Tomato  Method  In a large bowl, add chicken pieces with salt, garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin powder, garam masala, coriander powder, turmeric powder, garlic paste, red chili powder, yogurt, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well until the chicken is fully coated. Cover and marinate for at least 1–2 hours (overnight for the best flavor). Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove and set aside. In the same pan, add 2 tbsp butter. Add diced onion and cook until soft and lightly golden. Add garlic paste and sauté until fragrant. Add crushed tomatoes and tomato paste. Cook for 5–7 minutes until the sauce thickens and the oil starts to separate. Blend the sauce until smooth, then transfer it back to the pan. Add salt, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, red chili powder, smoked paprika, and heavy whipping cream. Simmer until creamy. Add the cooked chicken back into the sauce and coat well. Finish with 2 tbsp butter for a rich, glossy finish. Garnish with fenugreek leaves. Warm the tortilla wraps. Add mozzarella cheese, a generous amount of butter chicken, sumac onions, cucumbers, and tomatoes. Fold into a wrap and toast in a lightly buttered pan until golden, crispy, and the cheese is melted. #recipe #butterchicken #wrap

dinner with a dietitian: street corn inspired chicken rice bowls..you don’t even have to turn on the oven. 👌🏻 Flavor + Nutrition are my top 2 priorities when it comes to dinner. What I love about these: Balanced meal with lots of nutrition. Great for meal prep. Easy to customize. Full recipe below ⬇️ or grab it here: https://mallorythedietitian.com/street-corn-chicken-rice-bowl/ INGREDIENTS For Chicken • 1½ lb chicken breasts (or thighs) • 3 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil (1 for marinating + 2 for cooking) • 1½ tsp chili powder • 1 tsp each: smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Dressing • 1 c Greek yogurt • 2 Tbsp mayo • 1 lime, zest & juice • ½ tsp each: chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1-3 Tbsp water (as needed to thin it out) For Street Corn • 3 c corn, cooked • ½ red bell pepper, chopped • 1 small jalapeno, chopped • ¼ c red onion, chopped • ¼ c cilantro, chopped • ¼ c cotija cheese For Cilantro Lime Rice • 1 c jasmine rice, uncooked • 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil • ½ c cilantro, chopped • 2 Tbsp lime juice • ½ tsp each: garlic powder, kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Assembling (opt) • romaine  • avo • tomatoes DIRECTIONS 1. Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top w/cotija cheese & half the dressing. 5. Cook chicken: heat a skillet on medium-high. Add olive oil until hot. Add chicken & cook 3-4 min on one side. Flip & cook another 3-4 min until cooked to internal temp 165℉ (75°C) 6. Assemble: Add romaine (opt), rice, chicken & corn to a bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! Who else lives olives? 🫒 Recipe -  Olive and Garlic Cream Cheese Buns  / Ingredients: For the dough: - 350g all purpose flour (2 cups + 3/4 cup + 1 tablespoon) - 35g granulated sugar (3 tablespoons) - 7g instant dry yeast  (1 packet) - 7g fine sea salt (1 teaspoon + 1/4 teaspoon) - 50g unsalted butter, melted and cooled (3 tablespoons + 1 teaspoon) - 1 large egg - 150g warm milk  (1/2 cup + 2 tablespoons) - 100g grated Cheddar Cheese (1 cup) - 100g grated Emmentaler Cheese (1 cup) For the filling: - 200g Chive Philadelphia Cream Cheese - Green Olives - Kalamata Olives - Grated Emmentaler Cheese  - An egg, for an egg wash - Microgreens, for toppings Instructions: 1. To the bowl of your stand mixer, add the flour, salt, sugar, instant dry yeast, grated Cheddar and grated Emmentaler cheese. Whisk everything together. 2. Next, add the milk, egg and melted butter. 3. Using the dough hook attachment, knead on low speed until the dough becomes smooth and forms a ball, about 6-8 minutes. 4. Once ready, transfer the dough to a clean, lightly oiled bowl. 5. Cover and let it rise at room temperature for 2 hours. 6. After 2 hours, punch the dough down and divide it into 8 equal balls, about 105 g each. 7. Place them on a large baking tray lined with parchment paper, cover and let them rise for another 1 hour. 8. Preheat the oven to 180°C. 9. Brush each bun with the egg wash. 10. Fill each bun with a little cream cheese and top with the olives. 11. Sprinkle with more grated cheese. 12. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the buns are golden brown. 13. Once ready, top with microgreens and serve warm. #bread #breakfastrecipes #foodtok #asmr #baking

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

This recipe was absolutely banging. Solid 10/10. High protein, packed with flavour, meal prep friendly, and one of those meals where you keep going back for “just one more bite” until the bowl is mysteriously empty. The original recipe uses Cotija cheese, but I couldn’t find any, so I swapped it for feta and it worked an absolute treat. What you’ll need ✅ 800g chicken breast, diced Marinade ✅ 2 tbsp lime juice ✅ 1 tbsp avocado oil ✅ 2 tsp chilli powder ✅ 1½ tsp ground cumin ✅ 1 tsp garlic powder ✅ 1 tsp paprika ✅ 1 tsp salt ✅ ½ tsp african american pepper Salad ✅ 2 cups sweetcorn (around 2 drained tins) ✅ 1 large red onion, finely diced ✅ 1 large red bell pepper, finely diced ✅ 3 jalapeños, finely diced ✅ 1 handful fresh coriander, chopped ✅ 50g Cotija cheese, crumbled Sauce ✅ 250g 0% Greek yogurt ✅ Juice of ½ lime ✅ 1 tbsp hot sauce ✅ 1 tsp Tajín seasoning ✅ 120ml water ✅ Salt to taste ✅ African american pepper to taste Method Add the chicken, lime juice, avocado oil, chilli powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt and african american pepper to a bowl. Mixy mixy motherf**ker! Leave to marinate for at least 15 to 30 minutes. Meanwhile, drain the sweetcorn and pat dry with kitchen roll. Heat a large pan over high heat and char the sweetcorn until slightly blackened. Set aside to cool. Cook the chicken in a large frying pan until fully cooked through and slightly browned. In a large bowl, combine the sweetcorn, red onion, red pepper, jalapeños, coriander and Cotija cheese. In a separate bowl, add the Greek yogurt, lime juice, hot sauce, Tajín, water, salt and african american pepper. Mixy mixy motherf**ker! Pour the sauce over the salad mixture and stir well. Add the cooked chicken and give everything one final mixy mixy motherf**ker! Serve immediately or divide into meal prep containers. Macros (per serving) 🔥 Calories: 475 💪 Protein: 58g 🍞 Carbs: 21g 🥑 Fat: 18g Cheers: @amateurprochef

Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

Seafood boil This is the ultimate budget hack using imitation crab.  Ingredients  1 lb frozen shrimp imitation crab 1 lb potatoes 3 ears of corn  2 sticks butter Old Bay seasoning 1 lemon Instructions  1. BOIL THE VEGGIES: Boil a big pot of water with 2 tbsp Old Bay & a halved lemon. Toss in potatoes for 10 mins. Drop in corn for 5 more mins. 2. DROP THE SEAFOOD: Throw frozen shrimp straight in for 3 mins until pink. Kill the heat, gently fold in the imitation crab for 1 min just to warm it up. Drain it all. 3. THE SWILL: Melt 2 sticks of butter with the minced garlic for 1 min. Stir in 2 tbsp Old Bay and a squeeze of lemon. 4. THE DUMP: Throw everything in a giant bowl, dump the garlic butter over it, and toss. #recipes #food #cooking #seafoodboil #seafood

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

🌿 5-Minute Dump & Bake Chicken Pesto A ridiculously easy one-pan dinner that tastes fancy but takes almost no effort. If you’ve got 5 minutes, a jar of pesto, and some chicken, dinner is basically done. This dump-and-bake pesto chicken turns juicy, cheesy, and flavorful with almost zero prep—just season, spread, and bake. 🍗 Ingredients * 4 chicken breasts * Salt & pepper * Garlic powder * Oregano * 1 jar pesto * 6–8 slices mozzarella cheese Optional toppings (highly recommended) * Fresh tomato slices * Fresh basil * Balsamic glaze ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1️⃣ Prep (takes about 5 minutes) Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish or sheet pan. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and oregano. 2️⃣ Dump the pesto Spread a spoonful of pesto over each chicken breast, then dump the rest of the jar around the chicken so everything bakes in that garlicky goodness. 3️⃣ Bake Bake at 400°F for about 30 minutes. Cooking time may vary depending on the thickness of the chicken. Chicken is ready when it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 4️⃣ Add the cheese Top each chicken breast with sliced mozzarella. 5️⃣ Melt & finish Return to the oven and bake (or broil) for 10–15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly. ✨ Optional Finishing Touch Top with fresh tomato slices, fresh basil, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze for a caprese-style upgrade.

Процесс приготовления: 1. Для основы измельчаем печенье в крошку с помощью блендера, смешиваем с растопленным сливочным масло и формируем основу с бортиками (удобнее всего с помощью стакана) 2. Для начинки все ингредиенты берем комнатной температуры! Творожный сыр смешиваем с сахарной пудрой с помощью лопатки. По одному вводим яйца и после каждого тщательно перемешиваем венчиком. Добавляем сливки, лимонный сок и ещё раз хорошенько перемешиваем 3. Выливаем начинку на основу и отправляем чизкейк в разогретую до 130 градусов духовку на 1.5 часа (режим верх-низ). На дно духовки можно поставить емкость с горячей водой, чтобы поверхность чизкейка получилась гладкой без трещинок 4. Готовый чизкейк обязательно полностью остужаем, в идеале 2-3 часа при комнатной температуре, а затем ночь в холодильнике. BUN BO HUE aka my favorite food EVER 🥢 #bunbohue #vietnamesefood #noodles #easyrecipe #asmr  Bun Bo Hue Broth - Flank steak - Parboiled beef bones - Lemongrass - Pineapple - Ginger - Daikon - Shallot - Yellow onion - Water - Salt - Chicken bouillon - Mushroom bouillon - Fish sauce - Shrimp paste - Saté Parboil the flank steak and beef bones for 5–10 minutes, then rinse well. Add to a large stock pot with slightly smashed lemongrass, pineapple, ginger, daikon, shallot, onion, and a few spoonfuls of salt. Cover with water, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 1 hour, continuously skimming the scum from the top. Remove the flank steak and set aside to cool, then add the saté and simmer the broth for another 5 hours. Remove the onion, shallot, and ginger (I keep the daikon for my bowls) and season with chicken bouillon, mushroom bouillon, fish sauce, and shrimp paste. Taste and adjust to your preference. Saté - Shallot - Garlic - Lemongrass - Avocado oil - BBH seasoning - Red pepper flakes - Sugar - Shrimp paste - Fish sauce Sauté finely minced shallot, garlic, and lemongrass in avocado oil for about 5 minutes, until slightly golden and fragrant. Add a packet of BBH seasoning and red pepper flakes and sauté for another 2 minutes. Add half to the broth and reserve the other half for garnish. To the reserved saté, add a small ladle of broth, sugar, shrimp paste, and fish sauce, then sauté for another couple minutes. Bowl - Thick rice vermicelli - Cabbage - Bean sprouts - Sliced flank steak - Yellow onion - Green onion - Cilantro - Lime - Saté I like to prep all my toppings ahead of time and store them in glass containers for easy assembly throughout the week. Rinse and dry the cabbage and bean sprouts well, then store in a paper towel-lined container. Keep the sliced flank steak separate. For the noodles, boil for 10–15 minutes depending on thickness, then turn off the heat, cover, and let sit for another 10–15 minutes. Strain and rinse very well to remove excess starch, then let dry for about 15 minutes before assembling.

Serves: 4–6 Ingredients * 2 lbs chicken (thin-cut breasts, regular breasts, diced chicken, or boneless skinless thighs) * 1 (7.5 oz) tub Garden Vegetable Cream Cheese * ½ cup jalapeño jelly * ½ cup chicken broth * 3 tbsp ranch seasoning * Shredded mozzarella or pepper jack cheese Garnish with bacon crumbles or fresh parsley! Chicken Seasoning * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. 2. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray. 3. Place the chicken in the baking dish 4. Season the chicken with the garlic powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper. 5. In a bowl, whisk together:     * Softened Garden Vegetable Cream Cheese     * Jalapeño jelly     * Chicken broth     * Ranch seasoning 6. Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken. 7. Cover tightly with foil and bake according to the times below. 8. Remove from oven the last 5-10 minutes. take off foil, and top with shredded cheese. Place back in oven to melt cheese.  Remove and let sit for another 5-10 minutes to let the sauce thicken slightly. 9. Chicken is done when the thickest piece reaches 165°F. Spoon the sauce over the chicken before serving. Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thigh Rice Bake is an easy dinner the whole family likes!  INGREDIENTS 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs Olive oil  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and Italian seasoning 1 onion, chopped 1 tbsp minced garlic  1/2 cup Parmesan Garlic sauce  4 oz cream cheese  1 1/2 cups Jasmine rice 2 1/2 cups chicken broth  1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese  Parmesan cheese Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS Add 2 lbs of boneless skinless chicken thighs to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and Italian seasoning.  Heat a pan over medium-high heat with a little bit of oil. Quickly sear the chicken thighs for a couple of minutes on each side and remove them from the skillet.  Turn the heat down to low and add the chopped onion, rice, minced garlic, cream cheese, Parmesan garlic sauce, and chicken broth to the skillet. Bring to a simmer and stir.  Add this mixture to a greased 9x13 casserole dish. Add chicken thighs to the rice and cover with foil. Bake at 375 degrees F for 40 minutes or until the chicken thighs reach an internal temperature of at least 165 degrees (ideally 185 degrees F) and the rice is cooked.  Remove the foil and add shredded mozzarella cheese. Place the chicken and rice casserole back in the oven under broil for just a couple of minutes to melt the cheese. Top with parmesan cheese and parsley. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #easydinners #chickenthighs

Pain au Chocolat Recipe 🍫🥐 An Delight of Tender Chocolate and Airy Pastry. The classic elegance of Pain au Chocolat enchants taste buds around the world. This French pastry is an irresistible delicacy, weaving its magic across palates. It's an experience that shouldn't be missed. Makes 8-10 pieces 🥛 Dough: - 180 ml chilled milk - 18 g sugar - 25 g fresh yeast - 35 g cold butter - About 6 g salt - 380 g flour (Type 550) 🍫 Filling: - 160 g cold butter - 16-20 dark chocolate strips 🥚 Brushing: - Egg yolk - 1 tbsp cream/milk 👩🏻‍🍳 Dough Prep: 1. Mix dough ingredients in a kitchen mixer, knead for 5 min. 2. Take needed butter from the fridge for lamination. 3. Roll dough to 21x25 cm. Lamination: 1. Halve 160 g butter lengthwise. 2. Fold dough over butter, wrap, chill 45+ min. 1st Turn: 1. Roll dough to 8-10 mm, fold in thirds, chill 45+ min. 2nd Turn: 1. Treat rolled dough, fold, chill 45+ min. 3rd Turn: 1. Roll, fold, chill 1-2 hours. 🥐 Shaping and Baking: 1. Roll proofed dough to 15x4 mm. 2. Cut 15 cm x 8.5 cm strips. 3. Place halved chocolate bars on dough, roll. 4. Put rolled dough, seams down, on parchment-lined sheet. 5. Proof 2-2.5 hours at room temp. 6. Brush with egg yolk, cream/milk mixture. 7. Preheat oven to 180°C (356°F), bake 20 min. Optional: Brush with maple syrup after baking. Enjoy your homemade Pain au Chocolat! 🥐🍫  #painauchocolat #dessert #cake #dessertrecipe

VIRAL CHUCK ROAST✨ my most popular recipe for good reason! I’ve received 100s of messages from you about how this recipe has become a staple in your family’s dinner routine 🥹 Some of you are making it WEEKLY and I’ve gotten so much feedback specifically that your kids are loving it - which makes me so happy! Let me know in the comments how YOU enjoy this easy recipe and share it with someone you think would love this crowd-pleasing chuck roast!  Ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast (about 4 pounds) 2 teaspoons kosher sea salt  1 teaspoon black pepper  Instructions: Preheat your oven to 325. Season the roast generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Add to a baking large casserole dish or Dutch oven, cover (with a lid or foil), and bake for 1 hr per pound of meat. Remove the roast from the oven and raise the oven temperate to 425.  Using two forks, shred the meat into large chunks. (If the roast is not pulling apart easily, put it back in the oven for 30 min). Toss the shredded pieces of roast around in the rendered fat and place it back in the oven, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes until you see some nice crispy ends.  Serve with mashed potatoes or roasted vegetables and enjoy! FAQs:  My roast is less than 4 lbs, how long should I cook it? Use the “hour per pound” method. How do I choose a good beef chuck roast? Look for nice fatty roast with lots of marbling. A roast that is too lean will not render enough juice. (Note: I have hit or miss luck with grass-fed roasts. Most are just too tough/lean and don't render enough fat for this preparation.)  How many people does this serve? A 4-pound roast serves 6-7 people. Do I need to sear it first?  Nope! The last part of the cook will give it some nice crispy bits without searing.  Did you add liquid? No, that is the juice rendered from the meat. Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Steak Loaded Potato Skins🔥 For those of you asking about the app, just search “Osta” on the App Store or Google Play 🫶 Crispy, cheesy potato skins loaded with juicy steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives… 🤤 Inspo from the goats @chefmikekubiesa & @burnt_pellet_bbq !! For the Potatoes: -5 large russet potatoes -1/4 cup olive oil -1 tbsp salt For the Filling: -Scooped potato flesh -1/2 cup milk, warmed -1/3 cup butter, softened -1/2 cup sour cream -1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar, grated -1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped -Seasoning salt, to taste For Frying & Topping: -Neutral oil, for frying -Triple cheddar @tillamook, grated For the Steak: -Ribeye or New York strip -Salt & black pepper For the Chipotle Sour Cream (Optional): -1 cup sour cream -1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo -2 garlic cloves -1 tbsp lime juice -1/2 tsp salt -Milk, as needed Instructions: 1. Wash & dry potatoes. Rub with olive oil, season with salt & bake at 425°F (220°C) for 50–60 mins until fork-tender. Let cool slightly. 2. Meanwhile, blend all chipotle sour cream ingredients until smooth, adding a splash of milk to thin as needed. Refrigerate. 3. Halve potatoes lengthwise & scoop the flesh into a bowl, leaving about 1/4 inch around the skins. Mash with warm milk, butter, sour cream, cheddar, chives & seasoning salt to taste. 4. Heat neutral oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry the empty skins in batches for 2–3 mins until golden & crispy, then transfer to a wire rack. 5. Stuff the skins with the potato filling, top with triple cheddar & bake at 350°F (175°C) for 15 mins until bubbling & golden. 6. Season steak generously with salt & pepper, then grill or pan-sear to your desired doneness. Rest 5–10 mins, then slice against the grain into bite-sized pieces. 7. Load the skins with steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives. Enjoy!! #dinnerideas #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #cooking

LOOK IDENTITY — AETHER NOMAD 9099 🛸🤎🤍🩶 📍 Date officielle de naissance du look : 22.08.9099 Un look imaginé pour une époque où la mode ne cherche plus à suivre le futur… elle vient directement de lui. Le pantalon cargo à double ceinture signé @flyerrer.official conserve l’ADN street des années 90/2000, mais ici, il est propulsé dans une autre dimension. Taille volontairement abaissée, volumes XXL, poches cargo, nuances beige poussière et chocolat : la silhouette semble avoir été retrouvée dans une archive venue de 9099. Cette fois, le haut change complètement l’histoire. La maille zippée à col montant et ses détails effet fourrure construisent une silhouette plus sculpturale, plus mystérieuse, presque extraterrestre. Sa palette claire dialogue parfaitement avec le pantalon et crée un contraste entre douceur, puissance et futurisme. Les deux ceintures deviennent une véritable signature visuelle. Les sneakers massives ancrent le look dans le présent, tandis que les lunettes futuristes et le chapeau que j’ai imaginé transportent l’ensemble bien au-delà de notre époque. 🕶️🛸 Et le plus important ? Je n’ai pas simplement assemblé des vêtements. J’ai construit une identité. La façon de porter chaque pièce, les proportions, les accessoires, les matières et l’attitude ont été pensés pour créer une silhouette que l’on remarque avant même de comprendre pourquoi. Aujourd’hui, les gens tournent la tête. Ils demandent des photos. Ils cherchent à comprendre. En 9099, ils chercheront probablement à comprendre d’où cette archive est arrivée. ⚡️ Conseil de style : Ne cherche pas à porter ce que tout le monde porte. Cherche à créer quelque chose que les autres n’ont encore jamais vu. La mode devient puissante lorsqu’elle ne demande pas : « Est-ce que ça plaît ? » Elle demande : « Est-ce que ça va rester dans leur mémoire ? » Un vrai look ne suit pas l’époque. Il lui donne quelque chose à rattraper. 🛸🤎🤍🩶🕶️ @flyerrer.official 🖤 @_startexceedend_ 🤍 #aethernomad9099

Crockpot Marry Me Chicken Orzo Creamy, comforting, and packed with flavor, this easy Crockpot Marry Me Chicken Orzo is a family-friendly dinner that takes minimal effort.  Ingredients 1.5 lbs chicken breast or chicken thighs, cubed 1/2 onion, diced 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato oil (from the jar) 1 tsp each salt, black pepper, Italian seasoning, paprika, and garlic powder 1.5 cups chicken broth 1 cup orzo 1/2 cup heavy cream Handful of fresh spinach 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, sun-dried tomatoes, sun-dried tomato oil, salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, and chicken broth to your crockpot. Stir to combine. 2. Cover and cook on High for 2 hours (if using cubed chicken) or until the chicken is fully cooked and tender. 3. Stir in the orzo and heavy cream. Taste and adjust seasonings as desired. 4. Cover and continue cooking for 25-35 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. 5. Stir in the Parmesan cheese and fresh spinach until the cheese is melted and the spinach has wilted. 6. Serve warm and enjoy! Tip: If the mixture becomes too thick while the orzo cooks, add a splash of chicken broth to reach your desired consistency. Garnish with extra Parmesan cheese and fresh basil for an extra pop of flavor. 🍅🧀✨ #easyrecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #dinneridea #comfortfood

Let sit for 3 hours (or overnight in the fridge for best results). - In another bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. - Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). - Remove chicken from marinade, letting excess drip off. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels.  - In a small saucepan combine honey, butter, brown sugar, ketchup, hot sauce, garlic powder and bbq sauce. Mix until well combined. Let it simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat - Brush chicken with honey bbq sauce on both sides - Slice buns horizontally and brush with butter, place into a pan on medium high heat and toast until slightly golden brown.  - Mix melted butter, parsley and garlic powder. ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese! Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Puerto Rican pollo guisado 🇵🇷🥘🍗🌿 Dinner ready in 30 minutes ⏲️  Chicken marinade  Drums (3x) and thighs (4x) 1 tbsp complete seasoning with adobo  1 tbsp of garlic powder  1 tsp of oregano and cumin 1/2 tsp salt 2 tbsp of sofrito  1 sazon packet  Drizzle of olive oil  Marinate for 30 mins to an hour  Pollo guisado  Half an onion  Half a green and red bell pepper  3 garlic cloves  Half can of tomato sauce  2 bay leaves  1/2 tsp adobo  1 packet of sazon 1/2 tsp chicken bouillon  1 tbsp of sofrito  Olives  2 medium sized russet potatoes  Directions  Clean your chicken and add seasonings, sofrio and oil to chicken and let marinate for 30 mins to an hour. Before cooking chicken take out the fridge to allow it to get to room temperature. In a pan add oil and brown chicken on both sides then remove chicken.  Add your onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic.  Add your sofrito, tomatoes sauce, seasonings and olive mixtung together. Allow to simmer until fragrant.  Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender. Medicube... what is really going on? Medicube Sudan Red dye scandal. On 24th July 2026, Hong Kong Customs issued a warning to consumers to stop using Medicube's PDRN Pink Collagen Capsule Cream after its government laboratory detected Sudan Red, a banned carcinogenic industrial dye. Medicube has responded by releasing an independent South Korean lab (Intertek) report showing that Sudan Red was 'Not Detected’ The investigation is still ongoing and we do not have all of the information to make definitive conclusions yet. This is not the first time Medicube have been under question due to possible Sudan Red contamination. In late 2025, there was a massive recall of certain red-tinted skincare products in China and Taiwan due to Sudan Red dye contamination traced back to raw material suppliers. Medicube denied being affected by this however they introduced a new formulation in March 2026 for their PDRN pink collagen capsule cream. As skincare consumers, we often assume that products on the shelves are safe. Cases like this are a reminder of why independent third-party testing plays such a vital role in protecting consumer safety. @oneeyebeauty_official 's website has a useful guide for spotting fake products online

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Cherry blossoms are among the most beautiful and admired flowers in the world. Known for their soft pink and white petals, these delicate blooms appear during the spring season and symbolize renewal, hope, beauty, and the short but meaningful nature of life. Cherry blossom trees, often called sakura in Japan, have become deeply connected to culture, art, poetry, and traditions across many countries. Every year, millions of people gather in parks, gardens, and streets to witness the brief but breathtaking blooming season that transforms landscapes into seas of pink and white. Cherry blossoms bloom for only a short period, usually lasting one to two weeks depending on weather conditions. This short life span is one reason they are so admired. Their beauty reminds people that life itself is temporary and precious. In Japanese culture, cherry blossoms represent the idea of living in the moment and appreciating beauty while it lasts. Festivals called hanami, meaning “flower viewing,” are held during the blooming season. Families and friends gather beneath the trees for picnics, music, laughter, and celebration while enjoying the falling petals drifting through the air like soft pink snow. The history of cherry blossoms dates back thousands of years. In ancient Japan, emperors and nobles admired the blossoms and wrote poetry inspired by them. Over time, the tradition spread throughout society and eventually became known around the world. Today, cherry blossom festivals are celebrated in many countries including the United States, South Korea, and China. One of the most famous celebrations outside Japan takes place in Washington, D.C., where thousands of cherry blossom trees bloom around the Tidal Basin each spring. These trees were gifted by Japan in 1912 as a symbol of friendship between nations.#fyp #fyp #fypシ゚viral #foryou #japan

Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11. Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Crispy Beef Street Corn Tacos 🌽🔥 Ingredients: For the Tacos: -1 lb ground beef -1 packet taco seasoning -2–3 tbsp salsa -1–2 tsp chipotle adobo sauce (adjust to spice preference) -Small flour tortillas -Shredded cheese For the Street Corn Topping: -1/2 cup low-fat cottage cheese -Splash of water (for blending) -1 to 1 1/2 tbsp light mayo -1 cup corn -1–2 jalapeños, finely diced -Chopped pickled red onion -2–3 tbsp cotija cheese -Fresh cilantro, chopped -Everything But The Elote seasoning -Juice of 1 lime For Finishing: -Hot honey -Lime wedges Instructions: 1. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the corn and cook until charred. Remove from heat and let cool. 2. For the Street Corn Mixture: Add cottage cheese and a splash of water to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a bowl and mix in: -charred corn -mayo -diced jalapeños -pickled red onion -cotija -cilantro -lime juice -elote seasoning to taste Set aside. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess grease if needed. Stir in taco seasoning, salsa, and chipotle adobo sauce. Cook for another 2–3 minutes until it’s all absorbed.  4. Place flour tortillas on a baking sheet (spray with oil if needed). Add a layer of shredded cheese, spoon in taco meat, then top with more cheese. Fold each tortilla in half. Place a baking rack on top of the tacos to help keep them closed while baking. Spray with avocado oil.  5. Bake at 425°F for 10–15 minutes, or until golden, crispy, and the cheese is melted. 6. Top warm tacos with the street corn mixture. Finish with a drizzle of hot honey and squeeze of lime. SO GOOD 😮‍💨😮‍💨 #fyp #explorepage✨ #easyrecipe #dinner #healthy

Make sure you do not go to the Agafay desert… you need to make sure you go to the further desert because it is absolutely gorgeous   I do think that I explain in my video, however, it goes a little bit deeper than just a city having small streets and being uncomfortable, because of the way that men act I think it is directly tied tourism , so while I would not say avoid Marrakesh, I would just say, be vigilant and ignore, and that speak to you if you’re alone. The bottom line is travel to Morocco is safe. Tourism and Morocco is safe. Moroccans are very kind in hospital people, so should you travel to Morocco? Yes. Morocco is safe for solo female travelers. Homemade Honey Bun Recipe 🍯🌼 The long awaited honeybun recipe! I know these don’t have any honey but they’re still so good! Recipe: Yeast mixture: 2/3 cup warm milk (160g) 1/4 cup warm water (60g ) 2 1/4 tsp yeast (7g) 1 tbsp granulated sugar (12.5g) Wet ingredients: 1/3 cup granulated sugar (67g) 1/4 cup butter, melted (57g) 2 tbsp oil (28g) 2 large eggs 2 tsp vanilla extract Dry ingredients: 4 cups + 1/2 cup flour, divided (520g) + (65g) 1 1/4 tsp salt ** Cinnamon to dust before rolling Glaze ingredients: 3 cups powdered sugar 3-6 tbsp HOT water 1/2 tbsp vanilla extract 1 tbsp corn syrup (optional) 1.)1.) In a bowl combine your milk, water, yeast and 1 tbsp sugar, allow to sit for 5 minutes to activate (you can skip the wait if you know your yeast is active or your using instant). Then whisk in your 1/3 cup sugar, butter, oil, eggs and vanilla extract.  2.)Then mix in your 4 cups of flour and salt and add the extra 1/2 cup flour as needed,  (You may or may not need the extra flour, add a tbsp at a time or until the dough is tacky but not sticky) knead for 10-15 minutes. Shape the dough into a ball then place the dough in a lightly greased bowl, cover and rest for 45-60 minutes in a warm place or until doubled in size. 3.) Once doubled in size roll out into a rectangle then sprinkle on your cinnamon, rub it in gently and roll into a log. Cut your buns out than place on a tray, slightly flatten then cover and proof for about 30 minutes or until rolls have risen until doubled in size 4.) Once rolls have doubled in size bake at 350 for 10-15 minutes or until slightly golden brown (Avoid overbaking as it can cause the rolls to become dry) 5.) Whisk together the glaze ingredients and while still warm dip the buns into the glaze, cool or enjoy warm 🫶 ** Tips - Bake the rolls until slightly golden brown, since they’re baked freeform they bake faster and can over bake easier leading to dry rolls - After cutting the rolls tuck the tail end of the dough strip under the bun to prevent unraveling while baking - I Like to spray my buns (or any yeasted dough baked individually) with water to help them stay soft (optional) #honeybakes2 #honeybun #homemade #fromscratch #bakingrecipe
